_doc: Lane 860 A.2b model parity corpus: ONE list both sides read. fixtures/<n>.json carry spec + bindings (the 854 D/web fixtures, copied); examples/<n> = chart-examples/valid/<n>.json (modules/visualization test resources) joined to fixtures/<n>.json's bindings; numeric/<n>.json are the record's section 4.1 cases, hand-written in the fixture shape, with an expect the Kotlin test asserts. bar-aggregate-overflow (R1: an aggregate past float64 draws as a gap) and bar-nul-keys (R2: a NUL category must not collide the pair key) are 860b's additions, spec + bindings only.
